correctness.rationale: Expanding both rank-one perturbations gives exact trace equation (1), with common determinant. Positivity ensures spectral radius strictly increases in trace. Matrix multiplication establishes strict adjacent maximum. Two real eigenvalues and positive spectral weights prove the log-convex balanced optimum for positive determinant, flat nonadjacent case at zero, and parity-dependent edge nonadjacent optimum for negative determinant. The n=6 trace factorizations were independently checked by exact rational matrix products; 1,989 finite checks cover edge cases but are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: Identifies an exact structural decision rule for temporal spacing of favorable/unfavorable conditions in a natural two-stage matrix-population model, including a sharp six-year reversal and a common maximum, for all period lengths and real vital rates. It separates sign-indefinite stage feedback from mere event frequency; useful for interpreting crop rotations and seasonal interventions without claiming direct field efficacy.
